text:
tara: heads-up: during a small burst Canary A->B we observed sampled debug traces where redaction was skipped. low volume but PII landed in debug storage.

kevin: oof. which routing path did the requests take?

tara: routing log: `route=/v1/chat tenant=acct-901 path=main -> fallback=debug-inspect (due to pool-pressure)`

leah: quick question: do we intentionally allow debug path to bypass redaction for live fallbacks? thought that was gated.

omar: current design: debug-proxy has a fast-path that can avoid redaction if the request carries inspect_token. fallback previously copied only sampling=true, not inspect_token or redact=true.

kevin: root cause = envelope rewrite lost redact metadata. simple bandwidth optimization introduced the regression.

ops-bot: incident/CRIT: exposure-detected acct-901 sample=2 requests flagged.

tara: proposed immediate fix: routing layer must always set `redact=true` when rerouting into any inspect-capable path unless tenant explicitly has `inspect_on_fallback:true`. deploy hotfix to preserve redact flag.

leah: UX/Console change request: add a per-tenant toggle (default: off) "Allow inspect on fallback" plus an adjacent warning icon explaining audit/retention implications. also surface a canary checklist flag: "fallback may enable inspect" when running rollouts.

omar: telemetry: emit event `fallback_inspect_attempt` with fields: tenant, route, dest_pool, original_priority, redact_preserved (bool), trace_id. set alert threshold >0 for prod tenants.

kevin: ops runbook snippet: if event occurs, 1) immediately block inspect path for that canary, 2) rotate retention keys for debug storage, 3) notify security + product.

tara: action items: 1) hotfix preserve redact on envelope (owner: omar, ETA: 4h), 2) console toggle + tooltip (owner: leah, ETA: 48h), 3) telemetry event + alert (owner: kevin, ETA: 24h), 4) runbook update (owner: tara, ETA: EOD).

omar: adding unit & e2e to simulate pool-pressure fallback and assert redact still true. will open PR with tests.

leah: note for legal: wording for toggle must include that enabling inspect-on-fallback grants temporary access to request bodies for troubleshooting and will be shown in tenant audit log.

kevin: nice. thanks for quick triage. lets not let this slip into release notes without security sign-off.

tara: closing loop: will post summary to #incidents after hotfix. :white_check_mark:
